title: Writing Task 1: Trends and Changes
verifiableTask: Redigir dois parágrafos de tendências sem inventar causas

content.text: para gráficos de linha (e tabelas com anos): subir, cair, estabilizar, oscilar, atingir pico — com
Ao final da aula você consegue:
escrever dois parágrafos descrevendo mudanças ao longo do tempo,
redigir dois parágrafos de tendências sem inventar causas.
Descreva com gestos e palavras (o professor desenha a linha no ar ou no papel):
→ fell slightly / 2015 and 2018 → remained stable / 2018 and 2020 → peaked at $5 / in 2021
o que um bom overview deve conter?
rise (rose), increase, grow (grew), climb, go up
fall (fell), decrease, decline, drop, go down
remain stable/steady, stay the same, level off (estabilizar após mudança)
peak at, reach a peak of
hit a low of, fall to a low of
a rise / an increase / growth / a fall / a decrease / a decline / a drop / a fluctuation / a peak
There was a sharp rise in… · …saw a slight decline
slightly/slight, marginally, gradually/gradual (lento e constante), steadily/steady
Sales rose sharply to a peak of 80 units, then fell gradually and levelled off at 50.

explanations.general: Correct answer: to become stable after a period of change

In 2000, the park received 120,000 visitors. This figure
1. Prices fell slightly in 2012. 2. The population grew steadily. 3. Unemployment decreased dramatically. 4. Exports fluctuated between 2000 and 2005.
Profits rose ___ $2 million ___ $5 million. 2. The rate fell ___ 3% (diferença). 3. It peaked ___ 70%. 4. In 1990, the figure stood ___ 40%. 5. The number increased ___ 1,200 (valor final).

questions.questionText: Prices fell slightly → There was a slight ______ in prices.

explanations.general: There was a slight fall in prices.

questions.questionText: The population grew steadily → There was steady ______ in the population. (substantivo)

explanations.general: There was steady growth in the population.
Profits rose from $2 million to $5 million.

questions.questionText: Which sentence invents a cause (not allowed in Task 1)?

options.text: Visitors rose because the park built a new hotel.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Visitors rose because the park built a new hotel.

content.text: Line graph — Average daily screen time (hours) for teenagers in Country X, 2008–2023
(1 para smartphones, 1 para televisão). Meta: 150–180 palavras. Sem causas!
+ adjetivo + substantivo em cada parágrafo. Confira preposições.
Escreva verbo / passado / substantivo / advérbio para 12 palavras de tendência.
to, by, from…to, at, stood at, peaked at
Escolha um gráfico de linha de notícias e escreva um parágrafo de tendências.
Grave 1 minuto descrevendo o gráfico de screen time.
Escreva a Task 1 do gráfico de screen time em 20 min (com revisão).
Escreva uma Task 1 (line graph) de material oficial em 20 min.

questions.questionText: Screen time: what happened to smartphone use between 2020 and 2023?

options.text: It remained almost stable / dipped marginally.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It remained almost stable / dipped marginally.

questions.questionText: What happened to TV time from 2008 to 2023?
When did smartphone time first exceed TV time?
TV time ______ off at around 1.5 hours. (estabilizou — grafia britânica)

explanations.general: TV time levelled off at around 1.5 hours (leveled — grafia americana).

questions.questionText: “Teenagers watched less TV because of smartphones” is acceptable in Task 1.

explanations.general: Falso: não explique causas que o gráfico não mostra.

content.text: 1 There was a slight fall in prices in 2012. 2 There was steady growth in the population. 3 There was a dramatic decrease in unemployment. 4 There were fluctuations in exports between 2000 and 2005.
1 from… to · 2 by · 3 at · 4 at · 5 to.
Consumption rose marginally from 300 to 310 cups between 2000 and 2005, then grew sharply, peaking at 450 in 2015, before dipping slightly to 440 in 2020.
